what_it_does: Describes a microcontroller unit (MCU) chip built using CMOSP18 FD-SOI (fully depleted silicon-on-insulator) technology that runs at 1.2 GHz. The design optimizes tightly coupled memory (TCM)—fast local memory closely connected to the processor core—to balance speed and power leakage. Uses two different memory variants: one tuned for maximum speed near the processor, another tuned to minimize power waste when placed further away. High-density memory cells reduce physical area and signal propagation delays.
